# ChoiceList

Radio rows joined into one rounded box, used for shipping rates, pickup locations and payment methods. The selected row takes an accent border and a 5% accent tint. An option can carry a panel that opens under it while selected.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/components/choicelist)

## Usage

```tsx
<ChoiceList
  name="shipping"
  label="Shipping method"
  value={rate}
  onChange={setRate}
  options={[
    { value: 'economy', title: 'Economy', description: '5 to 8 business days', end: <b>FREE</b> },
    { value: 'express', title: 'Express', description: '1 to 2 business days', end: <b>$14.90</b> },
  ]}
/>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | Shared name of the radios. |
| `value / onChange` | `string / (value) => void` | The selected option. |
| `label` | `string` | Accessible name of the radio group. |
| `options[].title` | `ReactNode` | Bold first line. |
| `options[].description` | `ReactNode` | Second line. |
| `options[].detail` | `ReactNode` | Third line, in grey. |
| `options[].end` | `ReactNode` | Content at the end of the row. `ChoiceEnd` gives a price with a note under it. |
| `options[].panel` | `ReactNode` | Opens under the row while it is selected. |

## Files

To use this on its own, copy this folder:

- `ChoiceList.module.css`
- `ChoiceList.tsx`

It also needs:

- [`src/primitives/Collapsible`](../Collapsible)
- [`src/primitives/Radio`](../Radio)
- [`src/utils.ts`](../../utils.ts)

Everything expects a [`Theme`](../../theme) somewhere above it, which supplies the colours, corners and timings.
